Name: Piper - a Pierre Rewrite 'n Replace
Author: holychurros
Description:
[b][u]UPDATE - ******I'm happy to let someone taking over this mod and updating it for legacy usage. Please message me and I'll approve an official takeover******[/u][/b]

Why is Pierre such a jerk? He's not kind to Abigail at all! Caroline also has a sad story it seems. So I leaned into that. Pierre is now her far distant ex-husband you never see, and she finds Piper when Abby is just a wee tot. They are great moms to Abby, but there's more to the story now...

[b]***>>>CODING & DIALOGUE: HOLYCHURROS || PORTAITS & SPRITES: STANLOONA420<<<***[/b]
[size=1][i][b][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71935143]stanloona420[/url][/u][/b] is my modding partner, and please check out all of her incredible portrait mods![/i][/size]

Then this is the mod for you!

﻿[b]MAJOR DIFFERENCES[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]CAROLINE[/b] has an ex-husband, Pierre. We are finishing a visual mod to [b]CHANGE THE STORE NAME.[/b]
[*][b]PIPER[/b] has had her gifting [b][u][i]RESET TO MATCH PIERRE'S UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.[/i][/u][/b]
[*][b]ABIGAIL [/b]has dialogue changes, but has no portrait changes. Her frustration with her parents has a different tone.
[/list]
[b]CURRENTLY[/b]:
[list]
[*]Rewrites the entire story of [b]PIERRE[/b] from a grubby, greedy jerk of a father to [b]PIPER[/b], a wonderful wife to Caroline and great stepmom to Abigail.
[*]Rewrites the entire story of [b]CAROLINE[/b] to where if befriended, you'll find out more of her backstory!
[*]Rewrites [b]ABIGAIL[/b] slightly, mostly the relationship toward her parents and her dreams of living in the valley.
[*]Rewrites all heart events to make more sense toward the new family dynamic.
[*]Should be [b]SVE COMPATIBLE[/b]. Let me know if it is not.
[/list]
[b]FUTURE UPDATES[/b]:
[list]
[*]We currently have [b]NOT MADE THIS SEASONAL YET.[/b] That was on purpose as this is part of a larger project we are working on. We have the work, but it's going to be a bit before we can put it all together. - If you're interested in helping out with that, DM me!
[*]We hope to redo the store name from Pierre's to something more appropriate. If you're interested in assisting with that, DM me!
[*][b]A SIGN UPDATE IS MADE[/b] but the coding is still being adjusted. Apologies on this delay.
[/list]
[b]OTHER CHARACTERS[/b]:
[list]
[*]I plan to rewrite other characters as well, so feel free to comment with thoughts please! 
[/list]
To install, just have Content Patcher and SMAPI. Drop the folder in, and it should work for you! If not, please leave me messages so I can fix things for everyone! I use it and have had a lot of success.

I hope you enjoy it like we do!

Downloads.Description: Bug fixes and Grange event adjusted! - Please let me know if other mods affect overwrite this mod, and I can work to prevent that.
